context: Tests whether the agent correctly batches tightly coupled decisions (DL-001 user model + DL-002 validation in the same file) while implementing independent decisions separately (DL-003 logging in its own file), and whether it applies @decision annotations correctly, updates decision records, and runs the verification script.

checklist.name: DL-001 and DL-002 both annotated in models.py
checklist.description: src/models.py carries annotations for BOTH DL-001 and DL-002, reflecting that they were implemented together against the same code. They may share one annotation line ('# @decision(DL-001) @decision(DL-002)') or sit on separate declarations within the file - the kit permits sharing a line but does not require it, so both forms earn full credit. Award nothing only if one of the two decisions has no annotation in this file.

checklist.name: DL-003 in separate file
checklist.description: src/logging_config.py contains a @decision(DL-003) annotation AND does NOT contain @decision(DL-001) or @decision(DL-002), confirming DL-003 was implemented independently

checklist.name: DL-001 status accepted
checklist.description: decisions/records/DL-001.md has 'status: accepted' in its YAML frontmatter

checklist.description: The @decision annotations in src/models.py and src/logging_config.py do NOT have explanatory comments restating the rationale (e.g., no 'because we need X' or 'this uses Y approach' comments paired with the annotation)
